resources.string: Reports panel hardware-button presses to Home Assistant and enables tap injection from the panel control UI. Does not read screen content.
The configuration service is not ready yet.
Hardened mode is on. High-impact requests from the network need approval on this panel. Pending: %1$d.
Relaxed mode is on. Trusted-LAN features work without on-panel approval. Hardened mode is optional.
Hardened mode was not enabled because the panel could not verify that the LAN DevTools relay and its listener are stopped. Restart the panel, then try again.

Hardened mode was not enabled because ha-paneld could not durably clear and verify all owned classic/TLS network ADB state. The disable transition remains pending so startup will retry it; check Developer options, then try again.

Hardened mode was not enabled because the panel could not verify that classic network ADB and Android Wireless debugging are off. Turn off both remote-control paths in Android’s developer settings, then try again.
Hardened mode cannot protect physical approvals while classic network ADB or Android Wireless debugging is active. Turn off both in Android’s developer settings, then enable Hardened mode again.
The security-mode change could not be saved. Relaxed mode remains active.

Scan the code or open the address below on your phone or laptop — it takes about two minutes. Or tap %1$s to do it on this screen.
The broker rejected the username and password — fix them on the setup page in a browser.
Someone’s setting this up in a browser. Nothing to do here.

Continue on the setup page in a browser.
Connected. Next: the Home Assistant address.
Continue in the browser, or tap the button below to sign in on this screen.
Finish it in your browser to optimise the performance of your dashboards.

This device is a Home Assistant wall panel powered by ha-paneld. It provides the on-panel dashboard, app launcher and panel controls, while exposing the screen, LED, buttons, speaker and sensors to Home Assistant over your local network. Configure the panel from a browser using the address below.
Open this address in a browser to configure the panel
Scan to open the config page on your phone
Quick access for administering this panel. The dashboard is the panel’s home screen.
optimising which entities it uses (it may reload again as the panel learns)
%1$d s elapsed · learning this panel’s timing
Network link connected\nWaiting for a network address

The panel’s web viewer dropped Home Assistant during a page change. The panel keeps trying. If it keeps failing, the web viewer needs updating or repairing; it is called Android System WebView, and reinstalling the same build repairs a damaged one.
Home Assistant opened but will not respond

The page loaded, but the panel cannot control it, so nothing on the dashboard would work. The panel keeps trying. If it keeps failing, the web viewer needs updating or repairing; it is called Android System WebView, and reinstalling the same build repairs a damaged one.
The saved Home Assistant login stopped working, so the panel has stopped retrying it.
Fix: open %1$s → Home Assistant connection, then use Browser sign-in. The dashboard reloads automatically when the login changes.
The dashboard couldn’t be reached and will keep retrying automatically.
This panel has a known-good version and can install it now. It restarts once when it finishes.
This panel has a known-good version but is not allowed to install it, so this one has to be done by hand. Update it, then tap Retry.
No known-good version is bundled for this panel, so this one has to be updated by hand. Reinstalling the same version repairs a damaged one. Tap Retry afterwards.
This panel gets its Android System WebView from a store, which will replace it more safely than this would. Update it there, then tap Retry.
The installer made no change. Open Install to review the available System WebView version, then try again.
This panel does not currently have permission to install System WebView. Open Install to set up a permitted installation method.
The System WebView download did not complete. Check the network connection, then try again.
The System WebView download is larger than the panel’s safety limit. Open Install to review the available package.
A temporary problem stopped the System WebView update before it changed the panel. Try again.
There is not enough usable storage to stage System WebView. Free some space, then try again.
The System WebView package could not be prepared safely. Open Install to review the failure before trying again.
The update is waiting for the panel database to become safe for this operation. Try again after maintenance finishes.
Android rejected the System WebView installation. Open Install to review the failure; repeating the same attempt may not help.
The System WebView update was cancelled before it changed the panel. Try again when the panel is ready.
Downloading and installing. On a slow network this takes a few minutes.
The panel is already installing something else. Try again when it has finished.
The panel’s own service is not ready yet, so nothing was installed. Try again shortly.
The update stopped without saying why, and nothing on this panel was changed.
This panel’s web viewer is too old
The built-in dashboard needs a newer Android System WebView than this panel has. Another dashboard app on the panel may still work.
Making sure this version of Home Assistant works with the panel’s dashboard before opening it.

The panel’s built-in dashboard needs Home Assistant 2026.4.2 or newer, and this server reports %1$s. Update Home Assistant, then tap Retry. Only the built-in dashboard needs that version, so another dashboard app on the panel may still work.

The panel checks the version before it opens a dashboard, and the answer%1$s was not one it recognises. A proxy or a captive portal answering in Home Assistant’s place is the usual cause. The panel keeps checking.
Nothing can load until the panel has a Home Assistant login. The sign-in lives in this panel’s settings, under Home Assistant connection. The dashboard opens on its own once the sign-in works.

The saved sign-in stopped working, so the dashboard has not opened. Sign in again in this panel’s settings, under Home Assistant connection, and the dashboard returns on its own. Tap Retry instead if the account has been restored on the Home Assistant server.
Nothing can load until the panel has a Home Assistant login. Scan this to sign in from a phone:
The saved sign-in stopped working. Scan this to sign in again from a phone:
The panel cannot reach Home Assistant

The panel could not read the Home Assistant version, so it has not opened a dashboard. Check that Home Assistant is running and that this panel is on the network. The panel keeps trying.

Reason: %1$s

Untranslated diagnostic details:
%2$s
The Home Assistant connection is not ready yet.
The server certificate could not be trusted. Check its certificate chain and the panel clock.
The secure connection failed. Check the server’s TLS configuration.
The Home Assistant host name could not be resolved. Check DNS and the configured address.
The connection timed out. Check routing, Wi-Fi, and whether Home Assistant responds.
The host refused the connection. Check that Home Assistant is running on the configured port.
The network has no route to Home Assistant. Check the panel’s network and address-family settings.
Home Assistant or a proxy returned an HTTP error instead of its configuration.
The response was not valid Home Assistant configuration data. Check for a proxy or captive portal.
The connection failed for a reason the panel could not classify.
The Home Assistant sign-in page would not load
Configure opens this panel’s settings. Check the Home Assistant address there, or use Browser sign-in on the same page.
This account has no dashboard to open
Home Assistant lists no dashboard that the panel’s account is allowed to open. Create one in Home Assistant, or give the account access to an existing one. The panel keeps checking.

Home Assistant lists no dashboard that the panel’s account is allowed to open. The panel also could not clear the dashboard it had saved. Create one in Home Assistant, or give the account access to an existing one. The panel keeps trying.
Reading which dashboards this Home Assistant account can open, and which one it starts on.
Home Assistant did not answer when the panel asked which dashboards its account can open. Check that Home Assistant is running and that the panel is still signed in. The panel keeps trying.

The panel’s web viewer would not start Home Assistant. The panel keeps trying. If it keeps failing, the web viewer needs updating or repairing; it is called Android System WebView, and reinstalling the same build repairs a damaged one.
You need to finish the last important questions in your browser to optimise the performance of your dashboards
Skip and load the dashboard now
Skipping loads every entity Home Assistant has, which is slower on this panel. You can turn filtering on later under Configure → Dashboard.
Home Assistant refused the entity scan
Step 1 of 3 · Reading your entities — %1$d so far
Step 2 of 3 · Building the filtered set from %1$d entities
%1$s Home Assistant has not been opened, because loading every entity would make this panel slow. Try again, or turn the entity filter off under Configure, in the Dashboard settings.
The entity list saved on this panel is not valid, so it cannot be used.
This panel’s web viewer, Android System WebView, is too old to filter what Home Assistant sends. Updating it should fix this.
The panel could not set up the entity filtering this time.
Nothing is wrong with Home Assistant. The panel needs an answer about safety checks found while reading your entities before it can open the dashboard. Number requiring review: %1$d.

Nothing is wrong with Home Assistant. The panel needs an answer about safety checks found while reading your entities before it can open the dashboard. Number requiring review: %1$d. The same choices are available from another device at %2$s.
Nothing is wrong with Home Assistant. Too many entities were flagged to review on the panel. Open entity settings to simplify the dashboard, or tap Disable entity filter.

Home Assistant rejected this panel’s sign-in when the panel asked which entities to show. The dashboard has not been opened. Configure opens this panel’s settings, where Home Assistant connection holds the sign-in; the dashboard returns on its own once it works.
The scan of your entities did not finish, so the dashboard has not been opened. Check that Home Assistant is running and that the panel is on the network, then try again.
Home Assistant will open when the first filtered entity set is ready.
Once Home Assistant opens, it may reload a few times while the panel learns. That is expected.
Taking longer than usual — the panel is still working on it. If this doesn’t finish, the entity filter can be turned off from panel settings.
Normal panel services and database writers are paused. Keep this panel powered on; recovery is guaranteed only for this boot. Approve only the exact next step you requested.
Root helper is restarting or unreachable. No mutation is allowed.
Root journal response is malformed. Recovery is held.
Installed helper cannot run this recovery. Recovery is held.

Shizuku is not installed. Use the ha-paneld provisioning script once over ADB, then approve access here on the panel.
A package named Shizuku is installed, but its signing certificate is not trusted. ha-paneld will not connect to it.
Enhanced access is disabled in ha-paneld. Choose Enable here on this panel to begin local approval.
Enhanced access is enabled in ha-paneld, but the Shizuku service is stopped. Open Shizuku, start its service, then return here.
Shizuku is running and ready to show its local permission prompt. Request permission to continue.
Shizuku access was denied, so another permission prompt cannot be shown. Open Shizuku, choose Authorized applications, select ha-paneld, and grant access manually. Then return here.
The Shizuku service returned an unexpected identity or protocol version. Access is blocked.
Shizuku could not be connected. Close this dialog and try again.

The panel database failed its integrity check%1$s. Preserve it and open ha-paneld diagnostics before further writes.
